report:
Reviewed the complete transaction_isolation claim, ordinary unify.rs implementation association, and both associated tests. Independently verified exact byte equality of current unify.rs and semantic_spec.rs against historical implementation/test source snapshots; claim and implementation metadata are unchanged, and test metadata differs only by moving source into fragments. Historical rationale is consistent with the current evidence, not treated as execution.

Source assessment: try_unify_batch and try_set_bound pass partially mutating operations a child created by try_probe; successful completion rebuilds then calls collapse_into and returns effects, while an error calls discard. try_unify_required follows the same success/error ownership pattern. The ordinary associated incompatible_transitive_domain_union_rolls_back test first commits an Any/Integer equality, attempts the incompatible transitive Float equality, asserts DomainConflict with both domain kinds, and verifies both parent roots, the Integer domain, and parent semantic revision remain unchanged. These concrete assertions detect parent corruption from that failed domain union. They do not establish all failure, cancellation, or concurrent scenarios. Helpers used for this assessment are in the captured whole unify.rs file.

The second associated test, sage_meta::todo::inference_transaction_isolation, is an explicit empty verification placeholder, not behavioral evidence. Its prerequisite is completing the documented transaction matrix for failed occurs/universe checks, multi-entry response imports, candidate matching, cancellation and concurrent siblings, with observable parent-state and wake assertions. The complete claim also includes rollback of bounds, universe changes, tasks and staged obligations, isolation for every partially constraining operation, and exclusive-leaf atomic success; the current example and ownership code are partial evidence, while the remaining whole-parent semantic identity/no-publication and branch-isolation coverage stays deferred under that matrix. In particular no claim is made here that all cancellation/task/obligation paths or exclusive-leaf enforcement have been independently proven. Accepting the existing explicit TODO is justified and does not relabel the full guarantee as implemented or fully tested. No N/A entries exist.

Executed review start and exact source/metadata comparison; no behavioral tests or build run by this reviewer. Coordinator reports a passing root build and 321 functional sage-meta tests separately; those are baseline reports, not transaction-test execution evidence. No source changes or additional source dependencies used. No edits requested to the current partial-evidence and explicit-deferral accounting.
